description: Lists and searches events in the Mac's calendars (iCloud, Google, Exchange, and others), repeating events as their single occurrences, with each event's id. With id: that event in full (notes, attendees, alarms, repeats). With free: true, the free times of at least minutes (default 30) in the range, within hours (default 08:00-20:00), across all calendars. With nothing: the calendars and the next 7 days. Dates: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the Mac's time zone (optionally with Z or ±HH:MM); from defaults to the start of today, to to 7 days later (30 with a query).

free.description: List free times instead of events

hours.description: For free: the part of each day to look in (default 08:00-20:00)

id.description: An event's id, to read it in full

limit.description: At most this many events (default 50, up to 200)

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

minutes.description: For free: the shortest free time to list (default 30)

query.description: Words in the title, location, or notes

name: calendar_find
title: Find Calendar Events
